description: Single source of truth for allowed enum values, artwork specifications and catalogue conventions. Every seed row, API payload and published catalogue entry MUST validate against this file.

sections.label: Family
sections.description: Co-viewing content suitable for all ages.

sections.label: Trailers
sections.description: Promotional/trailer surface. NEVER rendered as a navigable section in the Viewer UI; trailers are surfaced only on a show detail page. Excluded from catalogue section grouping.

specs.usage: Vertical rail cards, show detail hero on mobile.
Hero banner on show detail and section spotlight.
Episode list rows and continue-watching tiles.

season_zero_is_trailers.rule: season_number = 0 is RESERVED for trailers and promos.
details: Season 0 MUST NOT appear in the normal season list rendered by the Viewer UI.
Season 0 episodes are exposed in the catalogue under a separate `trailers` array on the show object.
Trailer rows SHOULD use episode_number = null (or 0). A trailer carrying a real season episode number is a data error a validation report must flag.
Trailers are exempt from the `duration_seconds` minimum but still require artwork if published.

content_group_collapsing.rule: `content_group` identifies the same logical episode across language variants.
details: Two or more episode rows sharing a `content_group` value are language variants of ONE episode (e.g. an English cut and a Hindi dub).
The publish job MUST collapse them into a SINGLE catalogue entry whose `languages` array lists every published variant's language code, sorted with the default language first.
The pair (content_group, language) MUST be globally unique. Two rows with the same content_group AND the same language is a blocking duplicate.
A content_group value MUST NOT span more than one show.
Collapsed entry field precedence: title/synopsis/duration/artwork are taken from the default-language variant (en) when present, otherwise from the lowest-id published variant.

validation_rules.message: A published episode must have duration_seconds > 0.
A published episode must have all of poster, banner and thumbnail artwork.
The pair (content_group, language) must be unique across the catalogue.
A published show must be assigned to an allowed section.
Season 0 (trailer) rows must not carry a season episode number.
Artwork dimensions must match the declared aspect ratio for its kind within tolerance.
Artwork file must be 200 KB or smaller.
A published show must have a poster and a banner.
Value is not present in reference.json allowed values.
